variants.idea: Remove givens that nearly complete the bottom-right rows, columns and boxes, so singles are harder to spot.
Thin out column 9 and the row 7 cluster so fewer easy singles are available.
Remove givens that make singles easy in boxes 1, 5 and 9, forcing longer deduction chains.
Fewer givens spread across the grid, so no row, column or box is close to complete.
Remove givens from columns 7 and 8 so the right side needs elimination instead of direct singles.
Remove scattered givens that anchor the repeating digit pattern, which weakens easy cross-hatching.
Break up the dense row 2 and row 8 clusters that give quick singles.
Remove givens at the edges so the solver has to rely on more complex eliminations.
Make an already sparse puzzle sparser by removing two helpful givens in the center and right.
Remove right-side givens that anchor the top-right area, leaving fewer direct placements.
